title: Commercial Credit Account Schedule of Dispute Windows, Refund Minimums and Small-Balance Write-Offs
content:
The figures below apply per terms tier of the Commercial Credit Account. Amounts in USD.

| | Net 10 Starter | Net 30 Standard | Net 30 Preferred | Net 45 Business | Net 60 Corporate | Net 90 Strategic |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Dispute filing window, calendar days after the invoice date | 30 | 30 | 45 | 45 | 60 | 90 |
| Largest disputed amount the support desk resolves by credit memo | 50.00 | 100.00 | 150.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 |
| Business days to resolve an opened dispute | 10 | 10 | 7 | 7 | 5 | 5 |
| Smallest credit balance refunded on request | 25.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 | 50.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 |
| Refund method | check | check | ACH | ACH | ACH | ACH |
| Largest residual invoice balance written off | 5.00 | 5.00 | 10.00 | 10.00 | 25.00 | 25.00 |
| Days past the due date before a residual may be written off | 90 | 90 | 60 | 60 | 60 | 60 |

### Meaning of each line

- **Filing window** — calendar days after the invoice date within which an invoice dispute is accepted.
- **Desk credit authority** — the largest disputed amount the support desk may resolve by credit memo without Credit Department review.
- **Resolution days** — business days within which an opened dispute is resolved.
- **Refund minimum and method** — the smallest credit balance refunded on request (smaller balances stay on account) and the method used to refund a credit balance.
- **Small balance** — the largest residual invoice balance written off as a small balance, and the days past the invoice due date before a residual balance may be written off.

### Tier contrasts

- The Corbett Net 10 Starter and Net 30 Standard tiers refund by check; the four higher tiers refund by ACH.
- *Hypothetical:* on a tier whose desk authority is 100.00, a substantiated disputed amount of exactly 100.00 is within desk authority, and one of 100.01 is not.
